item.title: Las Vegas motorcyclist killed in high-speed crash near Jones, Tropical
item.description: A 22-year-old motorcyclist was killed in a Las Vegas crash Saturday night.

item.title: Animal Foundation to host Veterans & Valentines adoption event
item.description: The Animal Foundation is hosting a special adoption event dedicated to active duty and service members, as well as veterans.

item.title: Winner of Las Vegas chicken wing eating competition ate nearly 200 wings
item.description: The Wing Bowl, which until now has only been held in Philadelphia, came to Las Vegas, and the winner ate nearly 200 wings.

item.title: Dunkin' Donuts, T-Mobile, Budweiser take top Super Bowl LX commercial spots
item.description: Super Bowl LX brought fans of all ages together on Sunday for football, food, music, and, of course, the commercials.

item.title: 17-year-old killed in east Las Vegas hit-and-run; RV driver charged with DUI
item.description: A 17-year-old boy was hit and killed by an RV driver who drove away after the crash Saturday night. Las Vegas police later arrested the driver for DUI.

item.title: Crash closes east Las Vegas valley intersection
item.description: A crash closed an east Las Vegas valley intersection Sunday evening, according to RTC of Southern Nevada.

item.title: Las Vegas is one of the most romantic, cost-effective cities to spend Valentine's Day: study
item.description: Americans are expected to spend $29 billion this Valentine's Day. However, showing your romantic side doesn't have to break the bank. A new study showed that Las Vegas is in the top three most romantic and cost-effective destinations for Valentine’s Day.

item.title: Some fans head to Las Vegas sportsbooks over betting apps for Super Bowl
item.description: Out-of-town and local sports fans spent their Sunday at SuperBook Westgate Las Vegas for the Big Game, choosing the in-person betting experience over betting apps.

item.title: Nevada trooper shoots at driver who allegedly pointed gun during traffic stop
item.description: A trooper with the Nevada State Police shot at a driver who they said pointed a gun at them after troopers pulled them over for running a red light on Sunday morning.
